notes:
- 流光背景：修掉背景里的方形色块和直线拼缝，色团边缘恢复柔和渐变
- 更新检查：某个更新源连不上时不再导致整次检查失败，国内网络下也能正常发现新版本
- 深色模式下切换外观，背景不再出现空白
notesEn:
- Fluid background: fixed the square patches and straight seams; blob edges fade smoothly again
- Update check: one unreachable feed no longer breaks the whole check, so new versions show up on restricted networks
- Dark mode: switching appearance no longer leaves the background blank
